description: Java class defining the Alarm data model with properties, constructors, and methods related to alarm management in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: Alarm
classes.description: Data model class representing an alarm with properties such as type, severity, timestamps, and propagation flags.

methods.name: Alarm
methods.description: Constructor initializing Alarm with a specific AlarmId.

methods.name: Alarm
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new Alarm instance from an existing one.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the alarm type as the name, read-only.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the AlarmId, used for referencing the alarm.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the alarm was created.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the alarm based on cleared and acknowledged flags.

methods.name: toStatus
methods.description: Static method converting cleared and acknowledged flags into an AlarmStatus enum.

methods.name: getDashboardId
methods.description: Extracts the associated DashboardId from alarm details if present.
